messages:
morgan: quick RFC follow-up on ingress auth contract and per-route fallback behavior. want to nail who validates what and what headers we rely on downstream.
eli: clarify: public edge (ingress) vs internal API gateway? different threat models.
priya: both. edge should reject malformed signatures and expired tokens. gateway can enforce route-level permissions and richer claim checks.
taylor: agree on splitting responsibilities. also want clear observability so we can tell if rejects are ingress vs service.
ops: migration concern: we have org-scoped keys and we're rolling out project-scoped keys. what should happen if service expects project scope but gets org key?
morgan: my draft proposal: ingress performs minimal validation (signature, ttl, well-formed claims) and forwards standardized headers: `X-Actor-ID`, `X-Authn-Type`, `X-Authz-Claims`. authorization decision remains with the service by default. ingress can optionally enforce deny rules for obviously insufficient tokens.
eli: prefer ingress to fail-fast on obvious insufficiency (missing required scope claim for sensitive routes). but need a compatibility toggle so older clients don't break abruptly.
priya: strongly: fallback policy must be conservative. if route mapping missing -> deny. we can allow an explicit `org-read-only` fallback for low-risk endpoints.
priya: example config snippet:
```
ingress:
  minimal_validate: true       # sig, exp, json structure
  forward_headers:
    - X-Actor-ID
    - X-Authn-Type
    - X-Authz-Claims
  fallback: deny
  compatibility_window_days: 10
  legacy_prefixes: ["rwd-", "rwd-v1-"]
```
ops: `compatibility_window_days` is helpful. how does rate-limiting map across key types during migration?
taylor: include token type in headers (`X-Authn-Type`) and map rate limits by actor+type in the rate-limiter. instrument metric for legacy-prefix requests.
sec-bot: alert: key-rotation job will introduce prefix `rwd-v2-` next week; ingress should accept v1 and v2 during migration window.
morgan: add ingress flag `x-legacy-key` when a legacy prefix is used, so services can log or treat specially.
eli: also want explicit reject reason codes in responses/headers: `ingress_reject`, `service_reject`, `fallback_applied`. simplifies dashboards and postmortems.
priya: for services that trust ingress, provide an `trust-ingress: true` annotation; this means service will skip revalidation and trust forwarded claims. default remains `false` so services continue to validate.
ops: rollout plan suggestion: 1) implement header forward in canary, 2) enable telemetry and dashboards, 3) run compatibility window with logs-only flag, 4) enable ingress strict denies in staged regions, 5) full flip.
morgan: i'll put together a short RFC + checklist and include telemetry metrics (counts by reject_reason, legacy_prefix_hits, fallback_count). will post tomorrow. ping if there are blockers. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: ticket SEC-2026 created for ingress matcher + telemetry updates.
priya: i'll add unit/integration tests parsing `X-Authz-Claims` and verifying fallback behavior.
taylor: i'll build dashboard panels and add alerts for spikes in `fallback_applied`.
ops: coordinating canary regions, will share schedule.
morgan: thanks all, moving this to doc stage.
